strongest_observation: The three-direction unfused dynamic implementation is slower despite45.1381% projectionMAC. Fusing its auxiliary boundaries lowers the same synthetic whole-chain median from46.9870ms to28.1745ms,1.913x versus the same-run dense chain.

nearest_methods.preserved_scope: The direct original random-tensor implementation remains1.355x and fails its historical1.5x screen. CPU three-direction evidence remains an arithmetic fixture, not a native spatial result.
nearest_methods.substantive_change: Exploit rank3 centered token representation with only3 A projections per4 rows; fuse preparation, point packing, postQ2 pooling and inverse/gate/writeback rather than materializing all auxiliary expressions. Same shapes,seed,point count and quantizer; no tuning sweep.

nearest_methods.preserved_scope: 24 native raw three-action cases complete/rejected:0.231928% oracle gain over fixedNA;2.574103% larger SSE thanUB1.
nearest_methods.substantive_change: Within-FFN own-affine contrasts plus pooled nonlinear response, not cross-layer raw hidden-width allocation. No D0 repeat/extension.

nearest_methods.preserved_scope: Frozen learned BF16 full support passed, fixed hidden-greedy compression closed after7/16. No refit or support expansion.
nearest_methods.substantive_change: Prospective reuse of original A as spatial contrast, with input-space pooled responses rather than hidden support search. R14 backend uses random synthetic A; actual R9 A is not yet measured in this new operator.

reconstructed_operator.input: Current post-Q1 BF16 rows, original row order. Shared input contrast norm available before W1; actual source availability follows the pinned Q1/FFN hook, actual conditional value unknown.
reconstructed_operator.algebra: Three signed half-sums h_j of four rows; inverse signed half-sums of Ah_j give A(x_i-mu). Affine bias cancels. Different BF16 operation order from old direct L-minus-meanL.
reconstructed_operator.response: One W1/GELU/smooth2/Q2 response atmu or two atmu+c/mu-c. AveragepostQ2 then oneW2/bias perstripe; add individual affine contrasts, original gate/residual order.
reconstructed_operator.synthetic_common_path: PyTorch LayerNorm/AdaLN stand-in, not the exact Wan norm; same shared stand-in and native BF16 HiF4 entry for all7 arms.
